cache.note: Daily parsed caches are decoupled from the runner script version so audit/report-only patches do not force re-download.

daily_output.active_rule: Stage 3J alias interval active on calendar date
daily_output.storage: five compressed yearly CSV shards plus compressed per-day caches

matching.row_weight_deduplication: A GKG row contributes NUMARTS at most once to a matched production alias.

monthly_output.aggregation: sum daily matched NUMARTS / sum daily total NUMARTS over eligible active days
monthly_output.partial_membership_months: Retained with eligible_days reflecting only dates inside PIT membership/alias interval.
monthly_output.transition_months: Retained; daily PIT aliases are aggregated across the month without backcasting.

next_if_pass: Freeze H3 statistical specification and attention transformation before joining attention to any return/Winner outcomes.
